links.comparator_used: Physicians reviewing the AI-generated differential diagnosis list without the trust calibration prompt (control group)
links.effect: 41.5% in the intervention group vs 46% in the control group (95% CI -0.75 to 2.55; P=.27). Within the intervention group, accuracy of the trust calibration was a significant contributor to diagnostic accuracy (adjusted OR 5.90, 95% CI 2.93-12.46; P<.001).
links.quote: The physicians' diagnostic accuracy was 41.5% in the intervention group and 46% in the control group, with no significant difference (95% CI -0.75 to 2.55; P=.27).
